publication_summary: PHASE8-IMPL-019-T001 publishes and activates the guarded runtime extraction parent as docs/status only. PHASE8-IMPL-019-T002 is complete/PASS and accepts the Guarded runtime extraction boundary and environment model decision as docs/decision/status only.
